What we make

Honey is the product. Stewardship is the process.

Janway’s Raw Honey is harvested from our own hives around Baton Rouge and bottled without processing, filtering, or shortcuts.

10 Years

Hands-on beekeeping experience

Behind the jar

A working apiary with a local, family-owned rhythm.

Janway’s Raw Honey is family-owned and operated by Josh Janway in East Baton Rouge Parish. The work starts with careful hive checks, sustainable farming practices, and a commitment to harvesting honey without processing or filtering away its natural character.

Raw

Unprocessed and unfiltered from local hives.

Local

Harvested around Baton Rouge and nearby parishes.

Steady

Built on seasonal care and pollination expertise.

Sunflower season

Seasonal color, local honey, and a reason to slow down.

When the sunflowers are in bloom, Janway Farms becomes a bright reminder of the same pollination work that supports the hives, local crops, and the honey harvest.
